page.overview:
Who is Blue Mario?

Blue Mario refers to various unidentifiable counterparts of Mario who wear blue clothing.

One such character first made a minor cameo in Mario Tennis. Just like Yellow Mario, it is unknown whether he is just a colored copy of Mario or if he is a relative. Both he and the mysterious Yellow Mario also appear in the 4-player mode of the Mario Bros.
